en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European town taken from a grassy hillside with a dirt road in the foreground. Laundry hangs on long lines between young trees. Below, open meadows lead to dense rows of late‑19th‑century townhouses and villas with steep roofs and ornate façades. In the background, on slightly higher ground, stands a large church with a tall, slender spire dominating the skyline. Forested hills rise behind the town.
